source: NII CPS-IIP 特別警報・警報・注意報データベース (agora.ex.nii.ac.jp/cps/weather/warning/, Kitamoto; origin: 気象庁防災情報XML). Per-municipality lists warning_list.pl?acode=...
granularity: minute (issuedAt = start of that warning state; clearedAt = time it was cleared or replaced by another state, e.g. 大雪注意報->大雪警報 closes the former)
coverage: entries with issuedAt < 2026-04-01 and (clearedAt >= 2025-12-01), 4 municipalities; area codes 札幌市 0110000, 小樽市 0120300, 岩見沢市 0121000, 千歳市 0122400. Includes all warning types (also non-snow ones).
note: Times are as shown by the NII DB (JST +09). Entries issued before 2025-12-01 are kept only if still in force on/after 2025-12-01.
